findings.reason: without the partition in the done-when the §6 node cannot obtain the quiet node its measure requires, so the whole measurement repeats the confound it intends to fix.
findings.text: §6's deliverable asserts "its done-when names `all_debug`", but the section's done-when (line 134) names no partition, and the dispatch host submits a separate partition job only "when the done-when names one", so the re-measure would again run on the shared fleet node under load — the exact 2026-10-16 confound this change was made to remove

findings.reason: without a control (e.g. the base arm must be faster than head, or a repeat head pass must reproduce the same leading functions) the node's whole measure rests on an attribution that could be a plausible artifact.
findings.text: §18's done-when declares no negative control, where §6, §7 and §9 each name one, so its "at least 80 percent of the difference attributed" claim has no stated control a dispatch can run and a reviewer can check
